name: r3-q3-skip-lower-twin-clock
description: Fix round Q3 (B2): the lowercase key's device row has an uppercase twin, so upsertSettings' INSERT OR IGNORE of the upper-cased key succeeds (a new valve_settings row, its insert trigger) and the UPDATE resets that new row, not the stored lowercase one, which stays SKIP_TODAY; the tick goes on to the clock sync. Record legacy and --scoped.
